mapper.select: select greatest(0, (select reltuples::bigint from pg_class where oid = 'estate.apt_trade'::regclass)) as trade_rows, greatest(0, (select reltuples::bigint from pg_class where oid = 'estate.apt_rent'::regclass)) as rent_rows
select 1 from estate.apt_trade limit 1

select deal_year, deal_month from ${table} where deal_year is not null
order by deal_year desc, deal_month desc order by deal_year, deal_month
limit 1

select t.sgg_cd, coalesce(g.sgg_nm, t.sgg_cd) as sgg_nm, count(*) as deal_count from estate.apt_trade t left join public.g_sgg g on g.sgg_cd = t.sgg_cd group by t.sgg_cd, g.sgg_nm order by coalesce(g.sgg_nm, t.sgg_cd)
select sido_cd, sido_nm from public.g_sido order by sido_cd
select t.umd_nm, count(*) as deal_count from estate.apt_trade t where t.sgg_cd = #{sggCd} and t.umd_nm is not null group by t.umd_nm order by t.umd_nm

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, deal_count, avg_amount, median_amount, min_amount, max_amount, avg_area, avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.v_apt_trade_monthly where sgg_cd = #{sggCd}
order by ym

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(deal_amount)) as avg_amount, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by deal_amount) as median_amount, min(deal_amount) as min_amount, max(deal_amount) as max_amount, round(avg(exclu_use_ar), 2) as avg_area, round(avg(deal_amount / nullif(exclu_use_ar, 0)), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.apt_trade where deal_amount is not null
group by deal_year, deal_month order by ym

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(deal_amount)) as avg_amount, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by deal_amount) as median_amount, min(deal_amount) as min_amount, max(deal_amount) as max_amount, round(avg(exclu_use_ar), 2) as avg_area, round(avg(deal_amount / nullif(exclu_use_ar, 0)), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.apt_trade where sgg_cd = #{sggCd} and umd_nm = #{umdNm} and deal_amount is not null
group by deal_year, deal_month order by ym

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, count(*) as deal_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) = 0) as jeonse_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0) as wolse_count, round(avg(deposit) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) = 0)) as avg_jeonse_deposit, round(avg(deposit) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0)) as avg_wolse_deposit, round(avg(monthly_rent) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0)) as avg_monthly_rent, round(avg(exclu_use_ar), 2) as avg_area from estate.apt_rent where sgg_cd = #{sggCd} and umd_nm = #{umdNm}
group by deal_year, deal_month order by ym

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, deal_count, jeonse_count, wolse_count, avg_jeonse_deposit, avg_wolse_deposit, avg_monthly_rent, avg_area from estate.v_apt_rent_monthly where sgg_cd = #{sggCd}
order by ym

select deal_year, deal_month, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as ym, count(*) as deal_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) = 0) as jeonse_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0) as wolse_count, round(avg(deposit) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) = 0)) as avg_jeonse_deposit, round(avg(deposit) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0)) as avg_wolse_deposit, round(avg(monthly_rent) filter (where coalesce(monthly_rent, 0) > 0)) as avg_monthly_rent, round(avg(exclu_use_ar), 2) as avg_area from estate.apt_rent where 1 = 1
group by deal_year, deal_month order by ym
select g.sido_cd as code, g.sido_nm as name, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(g.geom, #{tolerance}), 5) as geometry from public.g_sido g where g.geom is not null order by g.sido_cd

select g.sgg_cd as code, g.sgg_nm as name, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(g.geom, #{tolerance}), 5) as geometry from public.g_sgg g where g.geom is not null
and g.sgg_cd between #{sidoCd} || '000' and #{sidoCd} || '999'
order by g.sgg_cd

select g.emd_cd as code, g.emd_nm as name, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(g.geom, #{tolerance}), 5) as geometry from public.g_emd g where g.emd_cd like #{sggCd} || '%' and g.geom is not null order by g.emd_cd

select substring(t.sgg_cd, 1, 2) as code, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(t.deal_amount)) as avg_amount, round(avg(t.deal_amount / nullif(t.exclu_use_ar, 0)), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.apt_trade t where t.deal_amount is not null
group by substring(t.sgg_cd, 1, 2)

select t.sgg_cd as code, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(t.deal_amount)) as avg_amount, round(avg(t.deal_amount / nullif(t.exclu_use_ar, 0)), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.apt_trade t where t.deal_amount is not null
and t.sgg_cd between #{sidoCd} || '000' and #{sidoCd} || '999'
group by t.sgg_cd

select substring(t.sgg_cd || t.umd_cd, 1, 8) as code, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(t.deal_amount)) as avg_amount, round(avg(t.deal_amount / nullif(t.exclu_use_ar, 0)), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2 from estate.apt_trade t where t.sgg_cd = #{sggCd} and t.umd_cd is not null and t.deal_amount is not null
group by substring(t.sgg_cd || t.umd_cd, 1, 8)
select to_regclass('estate.apt_complex')::text
select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where geom is not null) as geocoded, count(*) filter (where geocode_status = 'FAILED') as failed from estate.apt_complex
select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'estate' and table_name = 'apt_complex' and column_name = 'boundary'

select c.apt_seq, c.apt_nm, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(c.boundary, 4326), 6) as geometry,
round(ST_Area(ST_Transform(c.boundary, 4326)::geography))::bigint as area_m2 from estate.apt_complex c where c.sgg_cd = #{sggCd} and c.apt_seq = #{aptSeq} and c.boundary is not null

with picked as ( select c.apt_seq, c.apt_nm, c.sgg_cd, c.umd_nm, c.jibun, c.build_year, c.lon, c.lat, c.trade_count from estate.apt_complex c where c.geom is not null and ST_Intersects(c.geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minX}, #{minY}, #{maxX}, #{maxY}, 3857)) order by c.trade_count desc limit #{limit} ),
byPyeong as ( select p.apt_seq, round(t.exclu_use_ar / 3.3058 / 0.75)::int as pyeong, count(*) as cnt, avg(t.deal_amount) as avg_amount, avg(t.deal_amount / nullif(t.exclu_use_ar, 0)) as per_m2, min(t.exclu_use_ar) as area_min, max(t.exclu_use_ar) as area_max from picked p join estate.apt_trade t on t.sgg_cd = p.sgg_cd and t.umd_nm = p.umd_nm and t.jibun = p.jibun and t.apt_nm = p.apt_nm where t.deal_amount is not null
group by p.apt_seq, 2 ), summed as ( select apt_seq, sum(cnt) as deal_count, round(sum(avg_amount * cnt) / sum(cnt)) as avg_amount, round(sum(per_m2 * cnt) / sum(cnt), 1) as avg_amount_per_m2, round(min(area_min), 1) as area_min, round(max(area_max), 1) as area_max from byPyeong group by apt_seq ), mainPyeong as ( select distinct on (apt_seq) apt_seq, pyeong as main_pyeong, cnt as main_deal_count, round(avg_amount) as main_avg_amount from byPyeong order by apt_seq, cnt desc, pyeong )
select coalesce(json_agg( json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'geometry', json_build_object( 'type', 'Point', 'coordinates', json_build_array(p.lon, p.lat)), 'properties', json_build_object( 'apt_seq', p.apt_seq, 'apt_nm', p.apt_nm, 'umd_nm', p.umd_nm, 'sgg_cd', p.sgg_cd, 'build_year', p.build_year, 'deal_count', s.deal_count, 'avg_amount', s.avg_amount, 'avg_amount_per_m2', s.avg_amount_per_m2, 'area_min', s.area_min, 'area_max', s.area_max, 'main_pyeong', m.main_pyeong, 'main_deal_count', m.main_deal_count, 'main_avg_amount', m.main_avg_amount)) order by p.trade_count desc), '[]')::text from picked p join summed s on s.apt_seq = p.apt_seq left join mainPyeong m on m.apt_seq = p.apt_seq where p.lon is not null and p.lat is not null

select t.apt_seq, max(t.apt_nm) as apt_nm, max(t.umd_nm) as umd_nm, min(t.jibun) as jibun, max(t.road_nm) as road_nm, max(t.build_year) as build_year, count(*) as deal_count, min(t.deal_year * 100 + t.deal_month) as first_ym, max(t.deal_year * 100 + t.deal_month) as last_ym, count(distinct t.apt_dong) filter (where t.apt_dong is not null and t.apt_dong <> '') as dong_count from estate.apt_trade t
group by t.apt_seq

with rows as ( select round(t.exclu_use_ar / 3.3058 / 0.75) as pyeong, t.exclu_use_ar, t.deal_amount, t.floor, t.deal_year, t.deal_month, t.deal_day from estate.apt_trade t
), agg as ( select pyeong, count(*) as deal_count, round(avg(deal_amount)) as avg_amount, min(exclu_use_ar) as area_min, max(exclu_use_ar) as area_max from rows group by pyeong ), latest as ( select distinct on (pyeong) pyeong, deal_amount as last_amount, deal_year * 100 + deal_month as last_ym, floor as last_floor from rows order by pyeong, deal_year desc, deal_month desc, deal_day desc ) select a.pyeong, a.deal_count, a.avg_amount, a.area_min, a.area_max, l.last_amount, l.last_ym, l.last_floor from agg a join latest l on l.pyeong = a.pyeong order by a.pyeong
